description: MailBackend::blob_exists has a default implementation that always returns false. The doc says to override it, but it is a trait default, meaning a backend that forgets to override it will silently cause Email/parse to report every parseable blob as notFound instead of notParsable. This is hard to catch in tests because the MemoryBackend correctly overrides it. Contributor risk: anyone implementing MailBackend who does not read the full trait doc will ship a wrong notFound/notParsable classification.
title: blob_exists default returns false — silently wrong for any backend that does not override
